Class BBClientProxier

java.lang.Object
org.microbean.proxy.AbstractProxier<org.microbean.proxy.ProxySpecification>
org.microbean.proxy.AbstractToolkitProxier<org.microbean.proxy.ProxySpecification, DynamicType.Unloaded<?>>
org.microbean.clientproxy.bytebuddy.BBClientProxier
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientProxier
public final class BBClientProxier extends org.microbean.proxy.AbstractToolkitProxier<org.microbean.proxy.ProxySpecification, DynamicType.Unloaded<?>> implements ClientProxier
An AbstractToolkitProxier and ClientProxier that uses Byte Buddy to generate client proxies.
